## Sculpt kit API

```ts
/** A point or an Euler triple in metres / radians: [x, y, z]. */
type V3 = [number, number, number]

interface KitOptions {
  /** tessellation tier: 'draft' for iteration, 'standard' for review, 'hero' for the final render */
  quality: 'draft' | 'standard' | 'hero'
  /** seed for every procedural texture and jitter — same seed, same model */
  seed: number
  /** square texture resolution for the generated maps */
  textureSize: 512 | 1024 | 2048
}

/**
 * The sculpt kit. Everything a generated `createModel(kit, THREE, options)`
 * is allowed to build with. Units are metres, +Y is up, +Z is towards the
 * viewer. Geometry builders return a `THREE.BufferGeometry` centred on the
 * origin with computed normals; assembly helpers return `THREE.Object3D`s.
 */
interface Kit {
  /** Sharp-edged box. w/h/d in metres, e.g. box(0.8, 0.3, 0.75). */
  box(w: number, h: number, d: number): BufferGeometry
  /** Box with rounded edges — radius 0.005–0.03 m for furniture edges, up to h/2 for a slab. */
  roundedBox(w: number, h: number, d: number, radius: number): BufferGeometry
  /** The cushion primitive: rounded box whose faces bow outward. radius 0.04–0.12 m, bulge 0.01–0.04 m (added outside w/h/d). */
  pillow(w: number, h: number, d: number, o?: { radius?: number, bulge?: number }): BufferGeometry
  /** Cylinder along +Y. topRadius tapers it (default = radius); edge 0.002–0.01 m chamfers both rims. */
  cylinder(radius: number, height: number, o?: { topRadius?: number, edge?: number }): BufferGeometry
  /** Capsule along +Y: `length` is the straight section between the two hemispherical caps. */
  capsule(radius: number, length: number): BufferGeometry
  /** Torus in the XZ plane. arc in radians, default 2π; use π for a half hoop handle. */
  torus(radius: number, tube: number, o?: { arc?: number }): BufferGeometry
  /** Smooth Catmull-Rom tube through the points, constant radius. tension 0–1, default 0.5. */
  tube(points: V3[], radius: number, o?: { closed?: boolean, tension?: number }): BufferGeometry
  /** Polyline with a fillet at every interior corner — sled rails, tube frames, handles. cornerRadius 0.02–0.1 m. */
  bentTube(points: V3[], radius: number, cornerRadius: number): BufferGeometry
  /** Parallel-transport sweep; radius may be a function of t (0..1) to taper, e.g. t => 0.05 * (1 - t). */
  sweep(points: V3[], radius: number | ((t: number) => number), o?: { segments?: number }): BufferGeometry
  /** Revolve a profile of [radius, y] pairs around +Y — vases, knobs, turned legs. */
  lathe(profile: [number, number][], o?: { segments?: number }): BufferGeometry
  /** Extrude a 2D outline of [x, y] points along +Z by depth. bevel 0.001–0.01 m; holes are inner outlines. */
  extrude(shape: [number, number][], depth: number, o?: { bevel?: number, holes?: [number, number][][] }): BufferGeometry
  /** One draw call for many copies — slats, buttons, tufts. scale is uniform, default 1. */
  instanced(geometry: BufferGeometry, material: Material, transforms: { position: V3, rotation?: V3, scale?: number }[]): InstancedMesh
  /** Press a sewn groove between two surface points. width 0.004–0.02 m, depth 0.002–0.008 m. Mutates and returns the geometry. */
  seam(geometry: BufferGeometry, from: V3, to: V3, o?: { width?: number, depth?: number }): BufferGeometry
  /** Corded piping along a path — a thin open tube, radius 0.004–0.01 m. */
  piping(points: V3[], radius: number): BufferGeometry
  /** Upholstery button dome. radius 0.012–0.025 m, depth 0.003–0.008 m. */
  button(radius: number, o?: { depth?: number }): BufferGeometry
  /** Dimple a grid of tufts into the top and bottom faces. depth 0.01–0.04 m. Mutates and returns the geometry. */
  tuft(geometry: BufferGeometry, grid: { nx: number, ny: number, depth: number }): BufferGeometry
  /** Woven upholstery. weave 0..1 (thread density), contrast 0..2, sheen 0..1 (default 1), roughness default 0.88. */
  fabric(o: { color: string, weave?: number, sheen?: number, roughness?: number, contrast?: number }): MeshPhysicalMaterial
  /** Pebbled leather. grain 0..1 (cell density), gloss 0..1. */
  leather(o: { color: string, grain?: number, gloss?: number }): MeshPhysicalMaterial
  /** Wood with long-axis grain running along U. grain 0..1, tone 0..2 (band contrast), gloss 0..1. */
  wood(o: { color: string, grain?: number, tone?: number, gloss?: number }): MeshPhysicalMaterial
  /** Glossy painted metal or lacquer — flat colour, clearcoat 1, no maps. gloss 0..1. */
  paintedMetal(o: { color: string, gloss?: number }): MeshPhysicalMaterial
  /** Brushed steel or aluminium: metalness 1 with anisotropic streaks. roughness 0.2–0.5, default 0.35. */
  brushedMetal(o: { color?: string, roughness?: number }): MeshPhysicalMaterial
  /** Injection-moulded plastic — flat colour, roughness 0.4. gloss 0..1. */
  plastic(o: { color: string, gloss?: number }): MeshPhysicalMaterial
  /** Clear glass: transmission 1, roughness 0.05, thickness 0.01 m. tint is a faint body colour. */
  glass(o?: { tint?: string }): MeshPhysicalMaterial
  /** A named mesh, registered in the model's part table. position in metres, rotation in radians. */
  part(id: string, geometry: BufferGeometry, material: Material, o?: { position?: V3, rotation?: V3 }): Mesh
  /** Mirror a part across the x = 0 (default) or z = 0 plane; the clone's id is the original's plus "-mirror". */
  mirror(part: Mesh, axis?: 'x' | 'z'): Mesh
  /** Move `child` so its bottom sits on `parent`'s top, sunk in by `overlap` metres (0.005–0.03 for cushions). Returns child. */
  restOn(child: Object3D, parent: Object3D, overlap?: number): Object3D
  /** A named container for parts that move together. */
  group(id: string, children: Object3D[], o?: { position?: V3, rotation?: V3 }): Group
  /** Finish the model: returns a group named 'sculpt', centred in x/z with its bottom at y = 0. Return this from createModel. */
  root(children: Object3D[]): Group
  /** Seeded random in [0, 1) — deterministic for a given options.seed. */
  random(): number
}

/**
 * Build a kit bound to the caller's `THREE` namespace. `canvasFactory` supplies
 * the 2D canvases the procedural materials paint into.
 */
function createKit(
  THREE: typeof import('three'),
  options: KitOptions,
  canvasFactory: (width: number, height: number) => HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas,
): Kit
```
